messages:
Maya (Product): Kickoff — planning thread for next quarter: hosted API priorities for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank. Agenda: customer asks, OKR alignment, launch criteria, and scope tradeoffs. Please chime in with availability and initial takes.

Raj (Eng): I can join. Quick ask — what perf SLOs are we targeting? p95 chat latency, embedding throughput goals, etc.

Lina (Eng-ML): From model infra POV: quantization + KV cache + batching tweeks can net ~2x token throughput. Rerank has tighter latency tail though. Need experiments to be sure.

Sam (DevEx): Heads up — docs + migration guide are required GA items. If API surface stays small we can do quickstart + examples in 2 sprints.

Priya (Customer Success): Two enterprise customers have asked for per-route token caps and deterministic rerank behavior. They also want bulk embedding upload for large corpora.

Tom (Sales): Prioritization from sales: 1) embeddings bulk API 2) per-route SLA controls 3) rerank improved scoring. Embeddings scale will unlock >$70k ARR in next 6mo for one lead.

Maya (Product): Proposed priority order (initial): embeddings scaling + bulk API -> rerank latency improvements -> chat stability/streaming. I want to hear engineering tradeoffs before locking.

Raj (Eng): Real talk: bulk embeddings implies durable storage, async job queue, backfill, and monitoring. That's 2-3 eng sprints + one SRE for ops prep. If we push that now we have to defer some rerank work.

Lina (Eng-ML): Suggestion: ship a "beta-limited" bulk embeddings with constraints (max 50k vectors per job, eventual consistency for indexing) so customers can onboard while we mature infra. Cuts delivery time significantly.

Maya (Product): Proposed launch criteria for embeddings GA vs beta: GA: 99.9% success for 10k/day jobs, <1% quality regression vs baseline, full SDK + docs. Beta: opt-in, documented limits, onboarding support, clear SLA caveats.

Priya (Customer Success): Customers will accept beta if we scaffold onboarding and a clear rollback option. We'll need a short checklist for beta terms.

Sam (DevEx): We can deliver quickstart + one sample migration guide for beta in 2 weeks if API doesn't expand. Also need a changelog and migration notes for existing embedding users.

Raj (Eng): If we adopt beta-first, engineering estimate: 2 engineers for 6 weeks to build the bulk API + job orchestration + retries. SRE support for storage and monitoring onboarding. Rerank improvements can be a follow-up 3-sprint project.

Lina (Eng-ML): I'll run perf experiments for quant+KV cache to estimate cost delta. ETA: 10 business days; will post numbers and benchmarks.

Tom (Sales): I have 2 warm customers willing to be beta participants; can try to get a third if we have narrow eligibility.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll draft the beta terms and onboarding checklist once product locks the beta constraints.

Maya (Product): OKRs alignment draft: OKR-A: reduce per-embedding unit cost by 30% (metrics + expected tactics); OKR-B: achieve p95 chat latency <200ms on primary model family; OKR-C: onboard 3 customers to embeddings beta.

Raj (Eng): One more tradeoff: enabling aggressive batching helps cost but can hurt latency tail. Need policy: prefer lower cost for async embeddings, prefer latency for chat/rerank.

Lina (Eng-ML): Agreed. We should mark embeddings bulk as async-first, rerank/chat as latency-first routes in the routing/policy layer.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: embeddings-bulk-api — https://redwood.internal/rfcs/embeddings-bulk-api (please comment within 48h).

Maya (Product): Decision check — react :thumbsup: if we go beta-first for embeddings (constrained limits + opt-in), :thumbsdown: if we insist GA only.

Lina (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): :thumbsup: (will prepare eng plan + slides)

Sam (DevEx): :thumbsup: (docs on deck)

Priya (Customer Success): :thumbsup: (will prep beta comms)

Tom (Sales): :thumbsup: (will confirm 3rd customer)

Maya (Product): Action items from this thread: 
- Lina: perf experiments for quant+cache (ETA 10 business days)
- Raj: eng plan + resource estimate for bulk API (ETA 3 working days)
- Sam: docs quickstart plan for beta (ETA 10 days)
- Priya: beta onboarding checklist + customer comms (ETA 5 days)
- Tom: confirm 3rd beta customer (ETA EOW)

Next sync: Wednesday 10:00am PT in #product-planning. If anyone can't make it, post notes here. Thanks!
